calibration_resource_inventory.note: Lens datasheet values for the full sensor; it does not state the video crop/scaling, the distortion model, or the mounting pose.

calibration_resource_inventory.finding: Only states that camera_params 'contains camera parameters for the PIE dataset'. No model, convention, units or procedure.

No reference to calibration_data.json, K, D, homography or ground plane. Hard-codes 1920x1080. Reads ego-vehicle telemetry from <video>_obd.xml (OBD_speed, GPS_speed, heading_angle, latitude, longitude, yaw/roll/pitch, acceleration, gyro).

The GitHub directory page lists only calibration_data.json and camera_params.png. A recursive tree listing via the API could not be obtained (rate limit); the Phase 2 Task 4 audit (2026-11-11) recorded the same two files from a full API tree listing.
None for PIE. pedsafety/calibration.py defines a manifest format and checks but contains no PIE values. No homography, correspondence or calibration JSON exists in the repository.

intrinsic_evidence.raster_K_refers_to: assumed 1920x1080 as captured (dim field); pixel-centre convention of K is undocumented

consistency_checks.result: fx = 1004.8 px lies inside the tolerance band
consistency_checks.caveat: Assumes the 1920-px video width spans the full 7.14 mm sensor width. Not documented.

consistency_checks.result: Vertical offset of 33.6 px is plausible for a 16:9 readout window not centred on a 4:3 sensor, or for calibration noise. Cause undocumented.

hypotheses.model: OpenCV fisheye (Kannala-Brandt equidistant), D = [k1, k2, k3, k4]
supporting_evidence: cv2.fisheye.calibrate returns D with shape (4,1); cv2.calibrateCamera returns (1,5) or longer by default.
With H-D1 the horizontal FOV implied by K and D across 1920 px is about 116.1 deg; pure equidistant with no coefficients gives 109.5 deg; the datasheet states 110 deg horizontal.
Under H-D2 the third and fourth values would be tangential terms of 0.040 and 0.019, which are unusually large for tangential distortion.

hypotheses.model: OpenCV pinhole radial-tangential (Brown-Conrady), D = [k1, k2, p1, p2]
contrary_evidence: Undistorted pinhole HFOV from K alone is 87.4 deg; the small k1, k2 values raise this only to roughly 89 deg, well short of the 110 deg datasheet value.

distortion_evidence.conclusion: The distortion model is NOT documented. H-D1 is better supported numerically, but neither model is authorized for use until a straight-line (plumb-line) test on real video_0004 frames confirms it.

cam_height_open_questions: Reference point on the camera (optical centre, housing, mount) is undocumented.
Reference surface (road surface at rest, tyre contact plane) is undocumented.
Static value; vehicle load, suspension and road crown change it per frame.
cam_pitch_open_questions: Sign convention undocumented (negative is presumably downward tilt; not stated).
Reference axis undocumented (vehicle body, road plane, gravity).
Static value; braking, acceleration and road grade change the instantaneous pitch.
extrinsic_evidence.camera_motion: PIE is recorded from a moving ego-vehicle (vehicle-mounted camera). Any road-plane frame derived from the mounting pose is ego-vehicle-relative and time-varying, not a fixed world frame.
extrinsic_evidence.per_video_applicability: One global calibration file for the whole dataset. Whether it applies unchanged to set01/video_0004 (same unit, same mounting, same video crop) is not documented.

nominal_horizon_diagnostic.use: Visual sanity check only (compare against the apparent horizon / vanishing point in video_0004 frames). Not authorized for projection.

candidate_sources_not_yet_available: Camera height (1270 mm) combined with a verified pose and verified distortion model: would give an ego-relative metric ground mapping, but height/pitch semantics are unverified and per-frame pitch is unknown.
Ego-vehicle OBD/GPS speed from video_0004_obd.xml: could give a scale check through static ground features over time; file not inspected and not part of the confirmed pilot files.
Lane-marking dimensions: only usable if the road authority standard for the recording location is documented and the specific markings are confirmed to follow it.
Authors' rig calibration (checkerboard/ground target): not published in the repository.

image.frame_id: captured_1920x1080 (as emitted by the Phase 3 video source)
image.origin: top-left corner of the top-left pixel
image.bbox_format: [x_min, y_min, x_max, y_max], continuous edge coordinates
image.pixel_centre_convention: pixel_center_half (pixel (i, j) covers [i, i+1) x [j, j+1); its centre is (i + 0.5, j + 0.5))
image.pixel_centre_evidence: Ultralytics scale_boxes undoes the letterbox with a pure affine on continuous coordinates and clip_boxes clips to [0, W] x [0, H]; the Phase 3 in-frame check also uses [0, W] x [0, H]. Ultralytics does not state the convention explicitly. Any residual ambiguity (0.5 px) is far below the detector's localisation quantum (about 3 px in the original raster at imgsz 640).
image.distortion_domain: as_captured (distorted); no undistortion is applied anywhere in Phase 3

camera.proposed_convention_for_future_use: OpenCV camera frame: origin at the optical centre, +X right, +Y down, +Z forward along the optical axis, right-handed; units of length must be declared
camera.note: PIE does not document its camera-frame axes. The proposed frame is a project choice to be confirmed when extrinsics are obtained.

road_world.note: No origin, axes, handedness or physical unit is evidenced. For a moving camera any road frame would be ego-relative unless ego-motion is integrated.

relative_projective.note: Requires ground-plane correspondences that do not yet exist.

heading.image_space_definition: atan2(dv, du): angle from +u toward +v; because +v points down this is clockwise on screen; range [-pi, pi)

coordinate_conventions.transform_direction_rule: Every homography is stored image_to_plane (pedsafety/calibration.py enforces direction == 'image_to_plane'); inverses must be explicit.

video_decode.operation: OpenCV sequential decode; no resize, crop or undistortion

detector_preprocessing.operation: Ultralytics LetterBox to imgsz 640 (default config). For 1920x1080 with rect inference on a .pt model this is expected to be scale 1/3 to 640x360 plus symmetric padding of 12 px top and bottom to 640x384.
detector_preprocessing.letterbox_numbers_note: Derived from Ultralytics 8.4.212 code and the default config; the imgsz actually used for video_0004 must be read from run_manifest.json.

detector_postprocessing.operation: ops.scale_boxes(img.shape[2:], boxes, orig_img.shape): subtract padding, divide by gain, clip to the original image
detector_postprocessing.result: boxes returned by Ultralytics are in ORIGINAL video pixel coordinates, not model-input coordinates

phase3_pipeline.operation: Box validated against frame.width/height with 1 px tolerance; out_of_frame=reject (default). No coordinate scaling.

export.operation: bbox_xyxy written unchanged; no footpoint field in tracked_agents.jsonl or detections.jsonl

agent_state_adapter.operation: image_x, image_y = footpoint; image_coordinate_system = captured raster id; image_coordinate_unit = pixel; world_* null; world_position_valid false

image_transformations.homography_update_rule: If a future homography H maps raster R to a plane and points are expressed in raster R' = A R, use H' = H A^-1. For Phase 3 exports A = I, so no update is needed provided the calibration raster is the same captured_1920x1080 raster with the same pixel convention and distortion domain.

pedestrian.recommendation: Keep bottom-centre. Mark unreliable when y_max is within 2 px of the bottom image edge (truncated feet) or when occlusion is indicated.
pedestrian.expected_bias: Point lies between the feet; stride and loose boxes add a few px of jitter; lower-body occlusion moves it upward (toward the camera horizon, i.e. farther away on the ground).

car.recommendation: Bottom-centre is acceptable only as a relative proxy. It approximates the nearest visible bottom edge (front/rear bumper or side sill line), not the vehicle centre or the tyre contact polygon. Do not use for metric gap/TTC without a vehicle footprint model.
car.expected_bias: Ground position biased toward the camera; strongly view-dependent for vehicles seen obliquely.

bus_truck.recommendation: As for car but larger bias; frequently truncated at image edges in an ego-vehicle view. Flag border-touching boxes. Note PIE has no bus/truck ground truth.
bus_truck.expected_bias: Large footprint; box bottom often under the body overhang rather than at wheel contact.

bicycle.recommendation: Bottom-centre of the bicycle box approximates the midpoint between wheel contacts and is reasonable. When YOLO emits both person and bicycle for one cyclist, use the bicycle box for ground contact (person box bottom is the pedal/shoe, elevated).
bicycle.expected_bias: Duplicate person/bicycle detections are not de-duplicated in Phase 3 (documented limitation).

failure_modes.occlusion: Lower-body occlusion raises y_max; the footpoint moves up the image and maps farther away on a ground plane.
failure_modes.truncation: Ultralytics clips boxes to [0, W] x [0, H] BEFORE the Phase 3 pipeline, so detections.jsonl 'clipped' is false for real YOLO output and does not indicate truncation; a box with y_max ~= 1080 or x_min ~= 0 or x_max ~= 1920 may be truncated.
failure_modes.loose_boxes: Detector boxes at imgsz 640 have about 3 px quantisation in the 1920x1080 raster plus model looseness; this becomes large ground-plane error near the horizon.
failure_modes.partially_visible: Same as truncation/occlusion; no visibility score exists in the Phase 3 records.
failure_modes.elevated_objects: Riders, people on curbs/platforms, objects on raised medians: bottom-centre is not on the road plane.
failure_modes.sloped_non_planar: Road crown, grade changes, curbs and sidewalks violate a single-plane model; sidewalk pedestrians stand about one curb height above the road.

ground_contact_recommendations.exporter_note: Exporter behaviour matches its documented contract. The 'clipped' semantics limitation is a documentation/interpretation issue, not a defect; proposed isolated follow-up: a downstream derived flag touches_image_border (Phase 4 preprocessing), with no exporter change.

risks.risk: Moving vehicle-mounted camera makes any single homography time-varying; static calibration cannot give a fixed world frame.
Wide-angle lens (110 deg HFOV) with an undocumented distortion model; wrong model gives large edge errors.
Pixel or projective coordinates mislabelled as metres in downstream TTC/gap metrics.
'clipped=false' misread as 'not truncated' for real YOLO output.
Bottom-centre footpoint is not the ground-contact point for vehicles, occluded or elevated agents.
Calibration may not apply to this specific video (mounting/readout changes).
Findings about Phase 3 output rely on code; actual records not inspected.

recommended_next_actions: A. Run the read-only record inspection in Colab (checklist section A); no inference, no writes to the experiment folder.
B. Plumb-line test of the distortion model on a few frames read from the existing video_0004.mp4 (checklist section B); decide H-D1 vs H-D2.
C. Confirm the nominal horizon diagnostic visually on several frames (checklist section C) to test pitch sign and per-frame variation.
D. Ask the PIE authors (or consult the ICCV 2019 paper / supplementary) for the calibration procedure, distortion model, and pitch/height conventions.
E. Check whether video_0004_obd.xml is in the pilot download and document its pitch/roll fields and units (read-only).
F. Decide the Phase 4 target: image-space only (safe now) vs ego-relative ground plane (needs B-E plus correspondences) vs world-fixed (needs ego-motion integration).
G. Keep world_position_valid = false and kinematic_coordinate_space = 'image' until a manifest passes evaluate_metric_eligibility.
